shared_style: A polished friendly 3D children's cartoon render with rounded appealing shapes, soft matte materials, warm sunny outdoor forest lighting and natural ground shadows. One unified wide cinematic 16:9 frame, no text, no watermark.

challenge.subject: Exactly two animals together at a sunny outdoor forest-meadow race starting line across one dirt path: on the left stands the white rabbit with pink inner ears, small pink nose, and plain royal-blue sleeveless vest (no bow tie, no shorts); on the right stands the friendly green tortoise with fresh leaf-green skin, four legs, and a smooth rounded chocolate-brown dome shell with hexagonal scutes. Both characters face toward the race path ready to begin their friendly race in a colorful sunny meadow with wildflowers and green trees.
